card.name: Hello strings in code examples
card.fires_on: Mostly the words Hello, from and World inside quoted 'Hello ... Python/World' demo strings in programming documentation. Weaker hits occur on stress marks in pronunciation keys and on digits in dates or coordinates.

modes.label: Hello-world strings
modes.description: Words inside a quoted greeting string passed to a code function.

modes.label: Pronunciation marks
modes.description: The stress mark inside a bracketed pronunciation respelling of a place name.

modes.label: Digits in dates and coordinates
modes.description: A digit inside a date or coordinate in a reference or methods section.

card.plain: It mostly marks the sample greeting text in programming examples, with a few stray hits on pronunciation marks and numbers.
